CLR No.92 of 2025
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J (Through V.C.)
1. Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for 
the revisionist.
2. List this matter on 22.09.2025. By 
that time, the counsel for the revisionist 
may take steps to serve the respondent 
through counsel, who is appearing in the 
trial Court.
3. Since the dispute in between the two 
brothers in respect of a property, 
therefore, efforts should be made for their 
amicable settlement, therefore, on the date 
fixed, both the parties shall remain 
present in the Court.
4. The trial Court is directed not to 
close the opportunity of the defendant to 
file written statement.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 15.09.2025

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CLR No. 92 of 2025
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for 
the revisionist.
2. Mr. Sudhir Kumar, learned counsel 
for the respondent through V.C.
3. The dispute is in between the real 
brothers and there is possibility of amiable 
settlement in between both of them. The 
revisionist is younger brother and is 
present in Court.
4. Mr. Sudhir Kumar submits that if 
both the brothers are ready to settle the 
dispute he has no objection.
5. Put up this matter on 08.10.2025.
6. On that both the parties shall remain 
present in Court. The elder brother, 
namely, Sushil Kumar is no more however 
his legal heirs have not been arrayed as 
party. Since, there is a possibility of 
amicable settlement this Court is of the 
view that legal heirs of the brother, who is 
no more, shall also remain present in 
Court. 
7. Mr. Garg, undertakes that on that 
day one of the legal heirs of third brother 
will remain present in Court.
8. Interim order, granted earlier, to 
continue till the next date of listing.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 
22.09.2025
Parul
